caption_draft:
Your AI built the app. These 5 make it yours.

Pro Git — https://git-scm.com/learn — Full book, free to read online
MDN Web Docs — https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Guide/Modules — Split programs into separate modules
Chrome DevTools — https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/javascript — Pause code, examine all values
Supabase — https://supabase.com/pricing — 500 MB database on the free plan
Vercel — https://vercel.com/pricing — $0 Hobby plan, deploy in seconds

Save this for your next build. Send this to a friend who just shipped their first AI-built app.

#ai #webdevelopment #git #javascript #firstyear #coding #btech #notyourcollege
